_doc: Curation batch for the 78 proposed ent-* records (t/3118). AI-generated genus-differentia descriptions for human editing per the AI-drafted + human-edited policy (t/3131). Consumed by Import-Entity -Proposal. Records stay status:proposed; a human edits each description, sets description_provenance to 'human-edited' (persons REQUIRE this before approval once t/3131 lands), then approves. description_provenance is dropped by Import-Entity until t/3131 adds the schema field; it is included here forward-compatibly. Scalar 'aliases' are coerced to arrays. Two merges are encoded as tombstones (merged_into).
_provenance_note: description_provenance='ai-drafted' on every record below. Person records (ent-009/029/032/035/045/047/050/057/059) MUST be human-edited before approval (t/3131 gate).
_open_curation_questions: ent-049 vs ent-076 merge: canonical ent-049 is typed artifact; ent-076 was legislation/normative-description. An AI Action Plan is a government policy plan — reconcile ent-049's type (artifact vs legislation) on human edit.

ent-054 -> ent-042 merge is PROBABLE not certain: confirm the Sept-2025 announcement and the $100B partnership are the same event before applying the tombstone (left as a proposed update, not a merge, pending confirmation).

Low-value / low-confidence singletons not in the BDI corpus (ent-039 Moltbook, ent-065 Arcwise-Plat-Full, ent-003 GLM-TTS, ent-004 Office Agent) are candidates for 'deprecated' rather than 'approved' — curation judgment, left proposed.
